theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → Euclid P), LinearIndependent ℝ a → 0 < Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => inner ℝ (a i) (a j)) ∧ ∀ ξ : MultiVector P n, (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ α = (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => inner ℝ (a i) (a j))))⁻¹ * α a) → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range a))
